The '''Thirteenth Army''', also known as '''Iron Lance Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Trans-Nebular Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the 13th Sector Army had been given a sprawling theater of operations, in large part due to its responsibilities included the core territories of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The core territories had few Republic forces deployed there, save for the [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] base. The 13th Sector Army defended [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] against repeated [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attacks, as well as held the line against the Separatist attempt to cut off the Republic's Rimward forces at [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. It was also backed up by both the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army]] and the [[Fourteenth Army|14th Sector Army]] repeatedly.<ref name="TEGTW" />
